title: Shopify–NetSuite Two-Way Sync for CPG Brands Selling DTC and Wholesale
summary: Shopify orders, lines and customers map to NetSuite sales orders with owned fields, so a bundle order reconciles to its components and one ERP reference.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Connect Shopify orders and customers to the corresponding NetSuite records with explicit ownership for channel identity, ERP posting, and product packs. CPG brands need a shared order trail without flattening wholesale terms into DTC behavior. Establish the order and line crosswalk first; then add approved write-back fields and the workflows that depend on them.


Explore the complete[consumer packaged goods integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg) for the systems and processes around this guide.
